output.tldr: IRCTC is trading margin superiority for volume growth. While catering and tourism scale rapidly, the high-margin ticketing segment has stalled, and a massive working capital blowout signals deteriorating operational efficiency.

promises.promise: Maintain overall EBITDA margins at a floor of 30%.
promises.actual: Reported numbers show operating margins fell to 27% in Q4 FY26 and 28% in Q1 FY27.
promises.why: Margins have consistently trended below the promised 30% floor since Q4 FY26.

promises.promise: Achieve 15% sustainable revenue growth for the full year FY26.
promises.actual: Reported numbers show quarterly revenue growth of 18.3% and 15.1% in the final two quarters.
promises.why: Revenue growth met or exceeded the 15% target throughout the second half of FY26.

promises.promise: Enhance Danapur plant capacity from 1 lakh to 3 lakh bottles per day.
promises.actual: Management later revised the Danapur target down to 2 lakh bottles per day.
promises.why: The capacity target for the Danapur plant was reduced by 33% in subsequent guidance.

promises.promise: Maintain catering segment margins between 10% to 12%.
promises.actual: Catering revenue grew 33.8% in Q1 FY27, but overall company margins compressed to 28%.
promises.why: Segment-specific margin data is not yet fully disproved by the consolidated margin decline.

promises.promise: Submit proposal for final payment aggregator license by end of January 2026.
promises.actual: In Q1 FY27, management was still discussing the license as a future milestone.
promises.why: The license process appears delayed as it remains a 'medium term' goal in FY27.

promises.promise: Maintain Internet Ticketing business revenue growth at approximately 10%.
promises.actual: Reported numbers show internet ticketing revenue grew only 0.5% year-on-year in Q1 FY27.
promises.why: Ticketing growth has stalled significantly below the 10% target.

credibility.line: Management frequently misses its 30% margin floor and has overseen a catastrophic lengthening of the cash conversion cycle from negative to 132 days.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management claims to maintain a 30% EBITDA margin floor consistently.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Reported numbers show OPM compressed from 36% to 27% over the last four years.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management highlights robust revenue growth and business resilience.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Reported numbers show PAT fell 22.8% in Q2 FY27 despite 16.3% revenue growth.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Catering is described as a high-growth engine for the company.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Reported numbers confirm catering revenue grew 33.82% year-on-year in Q1 FY27.

bull.point: Strong revenue momentum in catering and tourism segments.
bull.evidence: Catering grew 33.8% and Tourism grew 20.9% in recent quarters.

bull.point: Massive scale expansion through Vande Bharat and Amrit Bharat trains.
bull.evidence: Rail Ministry plans to introduce 260 Vande Bharat train sets.

bull.point: Debt-free balance sheet provides significant financial flexibility.
bull.evidence: Reported numbers show a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.02.

bear.point: Severe deterioration in working capital efficiency.
bear.evidence: Cash conversion cycle lengthened from -1459 days to 132 days.

bear.point: Stagnation in the high-margin internet ticketing segment.
bear.evidence: Ticketing revenue growth slowed to 0.5% in Q1 FY27.

bear.point: Persistent operating margin compression across the business.
bear.evidence: Annual OPM dropped from 36% to 32% in three years.

watch_next: Approval of the RBI payment aggregator license for iPay expansion.
Stabilization of operating margins above the promised 30% threshold.
Impact of Vande Bharat sleeper train introductions on catering volumes.
